messages:
alex: Heads-up 1: supplier notified a port hold; our June reserved pallet split and a chunk moved to late July.
maria: Numbers? Which reservation IDs affected?
supply-bot: Manifest: [RC-12011, RC-12012, RC-12013] orig ETA 2026-06-14. New: RC-12011 -> 100 units 2026-06-21, RC-12012 -> 220 units 2026-07-27, RC-12013 -> 40 units 2026-07-30. Carrier note: "port congestion + validation hold".
chet: Who's on RC-12011? Any hard customer dates?
alex: RC-12011 -> CatalystBank pilot (90 GPUs, demo 2026-06-19). RC-12012 -> internal buffer + marketplace pilot. RC-12013 -> SI PoC.
yasmin: That 100-unit mini-tranche still misses CatalystBank's demo. Ops options: 1) accept supplier early-release mixed-SKU (80 units) + free 20 internal; 2) marketplace burst 40 GPUs; 3) partner loan of 50 GPUs.
legal-bot: Legal note: do not promise SLA credits in initial outreach. Use: "we're enacting mitigations and will pursue remedies under contract."
maria: Can we get supplier to airfreight remainder or reallocate from another hub?
supply-bot: Supplier offered 80-unit early release (mixed-SKU) ETA 2026-06-20 and airfreight option for +60 units if PO accepted within 6h. Surcharge estimate sent.
chet: Mixed-SKU acceptable if we run quick compatibility smoke. Ops estimates 46h validation. We can free 20 internal in 8h.
yasmin: Quick plan: accept 80 early + free 20 internal = 100 -> covers CatalystBank. If supplier airfreights extra 60, we regain buffer. I'll prep marketplace as fallback for 24h.
alex: Action items: @supply-bot get written BOL for early release and airfreight terms; @chet run mixed-SKU smoke tests and confirm driver parity; @maria draft cautious customer note; @legal-bot standby for wording.
maria: Draft: "We detected a supplier shipment timing change. We're enacting mitigations to keep your pilot on schedule and will share an update by EOD. No action required from you now." Legal ok?
legal-bot: Fine. Add: "we will pursue remedies under the supplier agreement as warranted."
supply-bot: Update: early release BOL attached to ticket; airfreight requires PO by EOD to lock carrier window.
chet: Validation started. Mixed-SKU smoke shows 95% parity on demo workload; two minor driver warnings logged and addressed.
yasmin: Marketplace procurement ready as fallback; provisioning ~6h once approved. Cost delta ~2.8x for short burst.
maria: I'll hold customer comms until we confirm early release docking. Want to avoid needless alarm.
alex: Sampler final: accept early release and delay PO until we see docking confirmation. If airfreight is needed, we'll approve. Keep this thread updated.
(supply-bot): Dock confirmed: early release 80 units cleared customs, ETA on-site 2026-06-20 02:00 UTC.
maria: Great 1 draft sent to CatalystBank with mitigation note and we offered on-call demo support.
chet: Freed 20 internal as planned. Combined sources cover the demo. Closing loop; postmortem after July windows close."
